summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including improvements to Spark integration and the addition of relative paths to the v4 spec. Recent discussions also focused on TLS configuration, parallel execution for Spark readers, and proposals for batch load endpoints in the REST specification.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Proposal for batch load endpoints in REST specification
